project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is stated as 'BIG ONE'. The text confirms this: 'Juggernaut Secures 100 % Option on Big One Gold Discovery' and 'the option to earn 100 % interest in the Big One property'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the text: 'Juggernaut Exploration Ltd (JUGR.V) (OTCQB: JUGRF) (FSE: 4JE) (the “Company” or “Juggernaut”) is pleased to announce that it has the option to earn 100 % interest in the Big One property'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company is named in the text: 'Dan Stuart, President and CEO of Juggernaut Exploration, states...'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement allows for a total of 100% interest acquisition through staged payments. 'Juggernaut can earn an additional 20% interest in the Property (for a 100% interest ) by delivering to the B-All Syndicate, by April 2, 2034, a NI 43-101 technical report...'

primary_commodity.justification: The headline of the article identifies the primary commodity: 'Juggernaut Secures 100 % Option on Big One Gold Discovery'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Big One project acquired by Juggernaut Exploration Ltd. A link to the company's website is provided in the contact information section: 'www.juggernautexploration.com'.

currency.justification: The cash component of the deal is explicitly denominated in USD: 'pay to the B-All Syndicate USD $1 million plus USD $1 for every gold equivalent ounce'.

cash_payments_raw.justification: A future cash payment is part of the option agreement to earn 100% interest: 'pay to the B-All Syndicate USD $1 million plus USD $1 for every gold equivalent ounce outlined in the NI 43-101 technical report.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is structured with the issuance of shares, but a total monetary value for these shares is not provided.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text describes the consideration in terms of share issuances and a future cash payment, but does not provide a single combined value for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total number of shares to be issued to earn 80% is the sum of two tranches: 'Juggernaut will commit to issuing 18,000,000 units on or before April 2nd, 2027... to earn 49%. Juggernaut can elect to pay an additional 18,000,000 units on or before April 2nd, 2033... to earn 80% of the Bigone property.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The deal includes warrants, but their value is not quantified: 'the units will have a 5-year warrant issued at market price on April 2nd, 2027'.

option_payments_raw.justification: The entire transaction is an option agreement, but there are no separate cash payments specified just to acquire the option itself.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.77'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not specify an exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not specify a monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the seller retains a 3% NSR: 'A royalty (“Royalty”) of 3% of net smelter returns (“NSR”) and other returns from all production from the Property will be payable to the B-All Syndicate...'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the property is stated in the text: 'The property covers 33,693 hectares in world-class geologic terrane...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: 'The property covers 33,693 hectares...'

resource_size.justification: The text does not contain a current mineral resource estimate. Instead, it outlines a future requirement to establish one, implying none currently exists: 'Juggernaut can earn an additional 20% interest in the Property (for a 100% interest ) by delivering to the B-All Syndicate, by April 2, 2034, a NI 43-101 technical report which includes an inferred resource calculation...'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph as '(JUGR.V)', where '.V' signifies the TSX Venture Exchange. The detailed quote section also confirms 'Exchange: TSXV'.
